articles.title: Gateshead FC: Prospective takeover of club close to collapsing
articles.summary: The takeover of National League side Gateshead is close to collapsing due to third-party involvement, according to prospective owners Flacks Group.
articles.body:
The takeover of National League club Gateshead is close to collapsing because of third-party involvement, according to prospective owners Flacks Group.

In an open letter , external written by the American private investment group, initially set up by Manchester-born billionaire Michael Flacks, the deal is in serious jeopardy after it was informed another party had agreed to buy the club from the current owners last March.

Flacks Group claims Shoreline Limited attempted to purchase the club but filed court documentation four months later to confirm that its agreement was null and void, and so proceeded to enter negotiations with the current ownership.

Flacks Group's takeover looked to be close to being completed earlier this month, subject to approval by the Independent Football Regulator (IFR).

Gateshead to be sold to American investment group

In finding out about Shoreline Limited's involvement, Flacks Group now claims that Shoreline has refused to respond to its inquiry over Shoreline's alleged involvement with Gateshead.

The group has also made an allegation that Shoreline are interested in buying an EFL club.

"We needed Shoreline to confirm in writing that it would give up any ownership claim it might have over Gateshead FC," an open letter read.

"We expected this to be an uncontroversial request since Shoreline's own court proceedings seek to confirm the cancellation of their purchase agreement.

"We needed their written confirmation as to ownership because, without it, we could not be confident that our takeover of the club would be free from dispute.

"Unfortunately, even though Shoreline's own legal case before the court asserts that they do not wish to own the club, Shoreline has refused to provide us with the written confirmation we have sought.

"This extremely frustrating situation is compounded by the fact that Shoreline are currently in the process of seeking to acquire another football club that are in the EFL.

"Regulations forbid any owner to take control of more than one English football club.

"Therefore, clarifying the ownership of Gateshead FC would not only clear the way for our rescue of the club; it would also clear the way for the Shoreline to acquire their other chosen club."

Gateshead have had a difficult season so far, on and off the field, and this will prove to be further bad news to already worried supporters.

The Heed have picked up just four points from their 14 National League games so far, losing each of their last eight league games, and are already 11 points adrift of safety.

They are still without a manager, having sacked Lee Cattermole at the beginning of the month, and staff and players had their wages paid late for the month of September.

Flacks Group concluded it is currently unable to proceed with the takeover in the circumstances and expects it will "reluctantly have to withdraw from the purchase" as it cannot acquire the club.

It added this is "not something we wish to do" and noted it was fully engaging with the IFR in the hope of achieving "a successful outcome for the club" as the group "seeks a resolution with Shoreline."

articles.title: Meet Muhammed Riswan, the Kerala freestyle footballer whose 2023 waterfall trick video went past 600 million views and has now helped him earn a global Instagram award in 2026
articles.summary: A football, a waterfall and one carefully timed kick.
articles.body: A football, a waterfall and one carefully timed kick. In November 2023, Muhammed Riswan filmed a short video at Keralamkundu Waterfall in Kerala's Malappuram district. He kicked a football towards the waterfall, making it appear as though the ball had disappeared behind the falling water. The clip was meant to be a fun video with friends. It went on to attract more than 600 million views on Instagram.Nearly three years later, the freestyle footballer from Kerala has received another international recognition. Riswan is among the 25 global creators selected for Instagram's Rings Award 2026. He is one of two Indian winners, with the other being model Bhavitha Mandava.Instagram's recognition comes after the video took him from a local waterfall to a worldwide audience. The platform described him as a Kerala footballer “whose gravity-defying skills and 600 million Reel views have taken him from local pitches to a global stage.”The waterfall kick that changed his lifeRiswan's viral video was filmed at Keralamkundu Waterfall in Malappuram and posted on November 18, 2023. It shows him kicking a football from a distance towards the waterfall. The ball appears to vanish behind the rocks and cascading water, leaving Riswan and his companion surprised. The response was much bigger than he expected. In an interview with Telangana Today, he recalled: “I never expected this to happen. It was just a fun video with friends. Within 10 minutes, it had around 2,00,000 views, and by the time I got home, it had already hit a million.”The reel has now crossed 600 million views. The video also earned him recognition from Guinness World Records. On January 8, 2024, his achievement was officially acknowledged as the most-viewed Instagram Reel at that time. He celebrated by returning to the same waterfall with his football and record certificate. This reel also got massive engagement on the social platform.How a hand injury changed his football journeyRiswan's interest in football began during childhood. He is from Mankadavu village near Areekode in Malappuram district and is the son of Abdul Majeed, a shopkeeper, as reported by The New Indian Express.He had hoped to become a professional footballer, but a hand injury while playing disrupted those plans. He later turned to freestyle football, a form of the sport that focuses on tricks, ball control and juggling using different parts of the body. He began learning tricks through social media tutorials and developed a style that took football beyond conventional pitches. His videos feature him performing tricks on rooftops, mountaintops and even underwater. The waterfall kick became his most widely recognised performance.The video had also taken him to Argentina. The Argentina Football Association invited him as a VIP guest to watch Lionel Messi play at the Estadio Monumental in Buenos Aires during Argentina's match against Venezuela in late 2025.He also recalled meeting Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni at an event in Dubai before travelling to Buenos Aires. “Scaloni shook my hand, and said my tricks inspired the squad.” The experience left him surprised by how widely the waterfall video was recognised. “We’ve seen your waterfall trick, it’s everywhere!” reporters told him, he recalled.Why Instagram selected him for the Rings AwardInstagram's Rings Awards recognise 25 creators from around the world for originality, creativity and their willingness to experiment with content. articles.title: Nicolas Jackson: Why Aston Villa is perfect club for Senegal striker to thrive at after Unai Emery reunion
articles.summary: Sky Sports analyses why Aston Villa was the perfect destination for Nicolas Jackson after his Chelsea exit; Jackson has scored seven in nine appearances across all competitions; watch Aston Villa vs Fulham live on Saturday Night Football, kick-off 8pm
articles.body:
His double to beat Manchester City and Enzo Maresca, the manager who sanctioned his exit from Chelsea in 2025, marked a full-circle moment. Jackson is not just recapturing his finest form, he is reaching new levels in his second stint with Unai Emery.

The connection between the two stretches back to their time at Villarreal. A bridge that was never burned and a partnership that always seemed likely to be reignited further down the line.

"Unai taught me everything about football," Jackson told Sky Sports in 2025. And with Emery guiding him once more, it seems as if class is back in session.

Sky Sports dives into Jackson's fast start in claret and blue ahead of another chance to impress when Villa host Fulham, live on Saturday Night Football .

A common theme during his time at Chelsea was frustrating form in front of goal. Across his two seasons at Stamford Bridge, Jackson converted only 18 of his 61 big chances (29 per cent).

So far for Villa, he has converted three of five (60 per cent), the caveat being it is only a small sample size. But his improvement stretches beyond that.

The 25-year-old has scored four goals in the Premier League from an expected goals (xG) value of just 1.98. Erling Haaland is the only striker overperforming by a greater margin, scoring nine goals from 6xG.

Jackson is taking the same amount of shots, around three a game, but his conversion rate has also skyrocketed from just 13.2 per cent in his final season at Chelsea to 21 per cent in 2026/27 so far.

The only time he exceeded that figure in the last five seasons was 29.3 per cent in 2022/23, his last season with Emery before the manager left for Villa.

The answer is a combination of things. After being named as the heir to Ollie Watkins' throne up front, with Tammy Abraham and Brian Madjo there to offer support, Jackson can take comfort from the knowledge that he is the focal point of the attack.

This, coupled with the freedom to roam across positions and the guidance of Emery, allows breathing room for a striker now away from the limelight and scrutiny that often comes with playing for Chelsea.

Villa struggled at the start of the season and failed to score until September 8, although Jackson's performances were positive.

In the same game that John McGinn broke that deadlock, a 3-2 win against Club Brugge, Jackson netted his first for the club. Neither he nor the team have looked back since.

Options and support around him have helped, too. In Johan Manzambi, Emi Buendia, McGinn, Senegal team-mate Ibrahim Mbaye and others, Jackson has both passers and receivers should he choose to venture forward or drift out wide.

"When I was from Senegal, I knew how to play but I did not understand how to run on the pitch," Jackson said in that interview last year. "I was just running like crazy, taking the ball and just dribbling, making my own stuff. [Emery] changed all that and made me into a different kind of player.

"Before, I was not playing like this, I was more of a kid. He trained me for six months and he left. He helped me a lot in the gym and tried to help me with my body.

"All of them (coaches) are amazing, but Unai is a big key to my football now."

That movement and growth continues to be fine-tuned by the Villa boss. Jackson currently ranks first amongst centre forwards in the league for dribbles completed (2.5) and runs ahead of the ball per game (7.7).

Now it is the demands of Emery, and Jackson's determination to prove a point in the Premier League, that will determine whether he can sustain - or build on - this form.

"We worked during the one year on his skill, he improved his understanding better," Emery said when Jackson signed for Villa. "Now he could exploit his potential."

"I will bring my spirit. Fighting for the badge, fighting for the coach, as I always do," was how Jackson responded in his first interview with his new club.

Emery demands a lot. Jackson is a player with a proven track record of meeting those lofty expectations.

The argument could have been made before the latest round of fixtures but it is a statement that is particularly pertinent given Chelsea's dismal loss to Tottenham.

Joao Pedro was sidelined with an injury and Chelsea played 78 minutes without a recognised striker. By the time the game had kicked off, Jackson had already scored twice to beat Man City.

During his time in west London, Jackson reached double figures in both campaigns in the top flight but the arrivals of Joao Pedro and Liam Delap, who has since left to join Nottingham Forest, created a surplus of strikers.

The loan move to Bayern Munich was a similar story. Newly crowned Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane was always going to claim that spot, and the arrivals of Danny Welbeck and Emanuel Emegha at Chelsea left little room for a resurgence in blue.

So an exit seemed like the only option. Atletico Madrid were also interested in signing him in the summer but were unable to meet the financial demands of a potential deal.

Jackson made the move to reunite with Emery, and the total package for that deal could reach a club-record fee of £65m.

Villa took the chance on a player who had shown promise in the Premier League but had not reached his full potential.

Watkins' exit, leaving big shoes to fill as he departed as the club's all-time leading goalscorer in the Premier League, added to that risk. But Jackson is already proving he can rise to the challenge.

He has now scored seven goals in his last nine appearances across all competitions, and while he looks forward to another chance to impress, Chelsea are the ones left looking back as they navigate the striker crisis at the club.

Jackson, still only 25, has found the perfect place to thrive and there is plenty more to come.

Watch Aston Villa vs Fulham live on Sky Sports Main Event and Sky Sports Premier League this Saturday, kick-off 8pm.

articles.title: MATT CALKINS: Megan Rapinoe defends biological males in women's sports saying sports were not meant to be fair
articles.summary: Megan Rapinoe's sit-down with W. Kamau Bell reignited the transgender athletes in women's sports debate with claims that drew sharp criticism.
articles.body: There is a reason that Megan Rapinoe only does interviews with people she knows won't challenge her. It's the only way the former soccer star won't end up red-faced or storming off in a fit of rage. Her answers leave her too vulnerable. Her comments sit on the summit of Mindless Mountain. Her recent sit-down with comedian W. Kamau Bell proved as much. MEGAN RAPINOE SAYS WOMEN'S SPORTS ARE FACING 'REGRESSION' OF 'EQUAL RIGHTS' IN NEW KAMALA HARRIS INTERVIEW Among the topics the pair discussed was trans people in women's sports, which Rapinoe has been a staunch advocate for. Here's how it started. Bell: "There's a lot of talk about how damaging trans women are to sports, so I give you credit for not being afraid to stand with trans people of all types, but also trans women in sports." Rapinoe: "I am appalled, I think at just, like, the lack of basic humanity and empathy that people are showing and just the amount of fear and hate, and I just think the silence of athletes is a lot." WASHINGTON HS GIRLS BLAST MALE ATHLETE PARTICIPATING IN TRACK MEET: 'DON'T THINK THAT THAT'S RIGHT OR FAIR' Basic humanity and empathy? Fear and hate? One could just as easily argue — or better yet, more convincingly argue — that she lacks empathy toward the women and girls who are losing competitions or sharing locker rooms with biological males. Last week, I saw a girl forfeit her cross country season because she chose not to race against a boy. She wasn't giddy about this. She broke down in tears while hugging her mother. Does Rapinoe feel empathy for her? As for athletes being silent? Megan might want to take that as a sign. It's probably not that they're afraid to stand with her on this issue — it's that they likely disagree with her, as do most Americans. And unlike Rapinoe, who can't lose a spot to a male, these athletes are still active and under that threat. The interview continued. Bell: "Why aren't you afraid of trans women in sports? Because that's the big fear is that it's like, suddenly it's LeBron James with a wig on, blah blah blah." Rapinoe: "Yeah, and that example isn't happening, and I don't think it's ever going to happen. I think there's a lot that trans people have to go through. If you're a trans person in sports to even play, it's like you couldn't just say, one day, 'I'm a woman' and go play. That's not how it works." Excuse me, but ... HAHAHA. That is exactly what happened with the high school cross country runner in Camas, Washington. He started the year on the boys team, finishing 76th in a junior varsity race. Then he switched to the girls team, where he's won one varsity race and finished second in three others. And not that it should matter, but he hasn't seemed to do anything to try and present himself as a girl. Not even a name change. So, yeah, Megan — it's happening. Rapinoe continued with the pièce de résistance: "And for me, one of the biggest things is God forbid somebody be good at sports and have some sort of advantage — and, by the way, sports is not fair in any sort of way ever. Right?" Bell (clapping his hands): "Yeah, it's not meant to be fair." Rapinoe: "Yeah, what's fair?" Bell: "I always point to [the 7-foot-4 Spurs center] Victor Wembanyama. Is that fair?" DAD BANNED FROM SCHOOL GROUNDS AFTER PROTESTING TRANS RUNNER COMPETING AGAINST HIS DAUGHTER Rapinoe: "What does that mean, even? It's already not fair, and also, just like, it isn't the most important thing in the world over someone's human rights or getting to play or being cruel to people. I don't know. I've won everything at every level, and played, you know in sort of every competition, and I'm just kind of like, I'm the one who could speak to it. Like, I'm okay if God forbid a trans person play sports and they're halfway decent at it." Yes, Rapinoe has won at everything at every level and played in every sort of competition. But do you know what one of those competitions was? Her U.S. National team playing a group of 15-year-old boys from Dallas and losing 5-2. So, in that sense, she is uniquely qualified to speak to boys playing in girls sports. She knows they'll kick girls' behinds. But even more asinine is the notion that sports aren't meant to be fair — along with Bell's attempt to equate Wembanyama's natural advantages with those of a transgender athlete. If sports weren't meant to be fair, there wouldn't be rules or referees. There wouldn't be punishments for performing enhancing drug use, weight classes in boxing or age limits in Little League. There is always going to be someone who's the best — whether it be Usain Bolt, Michael Jordan or Michael Phelps. But exhibiting athletic supremacy isn't unfair. Allowing men in women's sports, on the other hand, defies the very reason we separate the sexes. Simply put: If there was no separation, women's sports wouldn't exist. Personally, I don't think Rapinoe actually believes what she's saying. She saw firsthand what those 15-year-olds did to the best women's international soccer team in the world. articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo scores hat-trick to edge closer to 1,000 goals
articles.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo scores the 67th hat-trick of his career in Al-Nassr's 5-3 win against Al-Kholood in the Saudi Pro League.
articles.body:
Cristiano Ronaldo's hat-trick helped Al-Nassr to a 5-3 win against Al-Kholood in the Saudi Pro League and took the Portugal striker to 985 career goals.

With the game evenly poised at 2-2 following goals from Angelo Gabriel and Sadio Mane for for Al-Nassr, Ronaldo secured the win for his side by scoring three times in 15 second-half minutes.

His Portugal team-mate Joao Felix contributed four assists, including for two of Ronaldo's goals.

It was the 67th hat-trick of the 41-year-old's career as he continues to chase another milestone in a glittering career.

He has scored seven of his hat-tricks for Al-Nassr - along with 44 for Real Madrid, 10 for Portugal and three each at Manchester United and Juventus.

The five-time Ballon d'Or winner has won league titles in England, Spain, Italy and Saudi Arabia and is the all-time top goalscorer in men's international football.

He has spent almost four years at Saudi Pro League champions Al-Nassr, with whom he has one year remaining on his contract.

In August, he hinted at retirement by saying it was "probably" his last year playing.

Al-Nassr are defending champions in the Saudi Pro League and sit second in the table, although they have a game in hand on leaders Al-Qadsiah.

articles.title: El Celta conquista Japón desde su cantera: 200 futbolistas pasarán por Vigo esta temporada
articles.standfirst: El programa A Canteira Experience, según ha podido saber MARCA, prevé recibir cerca de dos centenares de futbolistas japoneses este curso dentro de una colaboración que arrancó en el curso 2017-2018
articles.summary: El programa A Canteira Experience, según ha podido saber MARCA, prevé recibir cerca de dos centenares de futbolistas japoneses este curso dentro de una colaboración que arrancó en el curso 2017-2018
articles.body: El Celta tiene una conexión con Japón que se mide sobre el césped. Un total de 34 jóvenes futbolistas del país asiático han coincidido estas últimas semanas en sus instalaciones de Vigo a través de A Canteira Experience, el programa internacional de Celta360. Unos disfrutan de estancias cortas; otros permanecen más tiempo para conocer desde dentro el trabajo del club. Todos comparten la oportunidad de entrenarse con la metodología celeste y acercarse a la rutina de sus canteranos. La previsión para esta temporada eleva la cifra hasta los cerca de 200 jugadores japoneses. Es una relación que arrancó en el curso 2017-2018, cuando el Celta y Wakatake Group iniciaron su colaboración, y que ha alcanzado a más de 500 futbolistas de Japón durante nueve temporadas. El viaje también tiene recorrido de vuelta: cada año, técnicos del club se desplazan al país asiático para impartir clínics y trasladar a sus campos la forma de trabajar de la entidad viguesa. El acuerdo con Wakatake Group permite que estos jóvenes se integren en el día a día del Celta. El entrenamiento forma parte de una experiencia que incluye el aprendizaje de nuevas habilidades, la educación y el desarrollo personal en un entorno exigente. El propósito es que cada participante pueda vivir la rutina de un canterano celeste, con acceso a los métodos de una estructura que tiene un peso tangible en el primer equipo: el Celta es el tercer club de las cinco grandes ligas europeas que más minutos concede a los futbolistas formados en su cantera. Su filial, el Celta Fortuna, logró además el ascenso a Segunda División la pasada temporada. La convivencia en Vigo acerca dos culturas futbolísticas a través del entrenamiento y el aprendizaje diario. Los participantes japoneses conocen una forma de trabajar centrada en el desarrollo del talento, mientras el Celta comparte su identidad con nuevas generaciones de jugadores. Celta360 quiere ampliar esa relación y atraer a más futbolistas del país asiático, con el objetivo de convertir la ciudad en un destino de referencia para su formación en Europa y extender el alcance internacional de A Canteira. Celta360 es el proyecto estratégico con el que el club busca transformar su ciudad deportiva en un espacio que reúna deporte, educación, salud, ocio, turismo e innovación. Nació con dos objetivos: reforzar la posición de la entidad en el alto rendimiento y la formación, y hacer de sus instalaciones un motor de desarrollo económico y tecnológico vinculado al deporte. Su planteamiento amplía la actividad del recinto hacia los ámbitos competitivo, académico y empresarial. Dentro de ese proyecto, A Canteira Experience ofrece a jóvenes futbolistas de todo el mundo la posibilidad de entrenarse y competir bajo la metodología oficial del Celta. El programa también incluye una oferta educativa y de residencia para los niños y niñas participantes, que pueden trasladar a Vigo tanto su aprendizaje futbolístico como su vida cotidiana durante la estancia.

articles.title: Lincoln Riley addresses speculation about his future at USC ahead of huge game against Ohio State
articles.summary: Lincoln Riley insists USC is where he belongs amid growing speculation that his job hinges on upcoming results against Ohio State and Indiana.
articles.body: To say that expectations were high at USC heading into the 2026 college football season would be an understatement. The Trojans, especially head coach Lincoln Riley, were adamant that this year would be different than the recent disappointments. SC finished 9-3 in 2025, brought in the number one recruiting class in the country, added some talent at key positions in the transfer portal, and returned starting quarterback Jayden Maiava after a strong 2025. They hired former TCU head coach Gary Patterson to run the defense. In theory, the elements had finally come together to return the program to prominence. And they said as much. "The time is now," the marketing campaign went. Riley gave interviews in the spring, including one to On3, where he said the administration got "serious" about competing at the highest levels of college football. LINCOLN RILEY’S USC TENURE COULD END WITH LOSS AGAINST OHIO STATE’S BACKUP QUARTERBACK, AND $70M BUYOUT "USC had to get really serious about being great in the sport again," he explained. " I give the school administration — everybody — credit. They have. "Taking this over, you knew you had to go fight like hell just to try to get this window opened," Riley said. "And we’re at a point right now where there’s a lot to be excited about and a lot in front of us. It’s been a lot of work for a lot of people, a lot of commitment from a lot of people to get there, and it should be a lot of fun these next few years." "We came here to win championships," he continued. " A lot of us have been fortunate enough to be a part of a lot of championships. We certainly didn’t come here for anything less. We’ve got to go buckle down and improve and really come together, but there’s the makings of a championship-level football team in that building right now." Fast-forward to late-October, and they're anything but. After an inexcusable loss to Wisconsin this past weekend, USC is now 6-2 and unranked in the AP Poll. While they had a nice win over Penn State in a hostile "White Out" environment in Happy Valley, the Trojans lost at home to a very mediocre Oregon Ducks team playing a backup quarterback. The seven points they scored against the Badgers on the road, after a bye week no less, represented the lowest point total of any Lincoln Riley-coached team. With a senior quarterback in his third season in the program and a very highly-paid offensive line. Naturally, the defense wasn't good enough to keep the game close. It never is. The performance, the record, the mediocrity, the consistent underachievement ... all of it has led to rampant, and growingly serious, speculation that Riley's job is contingent on a strong finish to the season. Perfect timing to host Ohio State and go on the road to face Indiana. CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE Part of the speculation is the assumption, or the observation, that Riley doesn't seem fully connected to the USC program. That he's ready to move on as much as the SC fanbase is ready to move on from him. He addressed those questions and opinions at a news conference this week, saying that he's fully committed to staying in LA and that SC is where he belongs. LINCOLN RILEY HOT SEAT RUMORS GET LOUDER AFTER 'FIRE LINCOLN' CHANTS DURING USC-WASHINGTON "Listen, if I didn't want to be at this place, I wouldn't have come here in the first place. I've had plenty of opportunities to leave," Riley explained Tuesday afternoon. "This is where I want to be. This is the right place for me. I'm the right person to be here. And that's as honest and transparent as I can be with you guys. "I love it here. I mean like I told you guys a lot of times — there's not many people in college football history that gave up what I gave up to come here," Riley said. "I don't care if it's 15 years down the line, that never should be taken lightly. It's certainly not taken lightly by me. I came here because I believe in this place and none of that has changed whatsoever." That's an interesting way to put it, because it's not exactly clear what Riley "gave up" to come to SC. He got a huge raise in salary. He locked in a massive buyout, ensuring generational wealth no matter how well he coached. He went from living in Norman, Oklahoma, to a palatial $35 million mansion on top of a hill overlooking the Pacific Ocean, acquired for him by USC. What was the big sacrifice he made? Theoretically losing favor with Oklahoma fans, but uh, you know, $100+ million can make up for some mean comments by anonymous message board accounts. Riley said that he has a great relationship with USC's Athletic Director Jen Cohen, and said she's been a "huge part of the progress that we've made." SIGN UP FOR THE DAILY OUTKICK NEWSLETTER Though again, it's not clear what progress he's referring to. USC went 11-1 in the regular season in his first year in LA, thanks in large part to Heisman Trophy winner Caleb Williams. They haven't won 10 games since, and have to win while playing three top-10 teams to do so in 2026. OUTKICK IS NOW AVAILABLE ON THE FOX NEWS APP: CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD As for his demeanor, which can sometimes give off the impression he doesn't care, Riley addressed that too. "When you're a head coach of a blue-blood school, you have to be ready to weather the storms, the overly positive or the overly negative," he said. "Typically, what I've learned from doing this for a few years, I haven't learned it all, but the truth typically lies somewhere in the middle. And that's typically where it's at even if you know that it's going to sensationalize. And so my job is to stay steady." Well, that's all true. And all well and good. But when your team comes out lifeless for road game after road game, loses games it should win to programs like Minnesota, Maryland and Wisconsin, and struggles against Oregon or Notre Dame, it's reasonable to question. Watching what Curt Cignetti has done at Indiana, or even Bob Chesney in his first year at UCLA, it's easy to see why there's such disappointment in Riley's work at SC. There's little toughness, discipline, or consistency on the roster. And always another special teams mistake. Riley might be committed to USC, but that's a two-way street. And Saturday's game, Ohio State playing with potentially a true freshman backup quarterback on the road, might be enough to end the Trojans' commitment to him. Baylor anyone?

articles.title: El 'rinascimento' de Álex Jiménez: "Vine a la Fiorentina para mostrarle a todo el mundo el futbolista que soy"
articles.standfirst: El lateral español es el jugador de la Fiore que más goles ha producido (6) esta temporada
articles.summary: El lateral español es el jugador de la Fiore que más goles ha producido (6) esta temporada
articles.body: "Empecé mi carrera en Italia y siempre quise volver al lugar donde debuté. Estoy muy feliz de estar aquí, en la Fiorentina. Al final, mi corazón está aquí", aseguró Álex Jiménez (Leganés, 2005) para justificar su decisión de abandonar el Bournemouth cedido con una opción de compra valorada en 20 millones de euros. En 'La Cuna del Renacimiento italiano', la misma ciudad que alumbró, entre otros, a Leonardo da Vinci, Miguel Ángel, Botticelli, Brunelleschi, y Donatello, está aflorando la mejor versión del excanterano del Real Madrid. El español, internacional sub 21, se ha convertido en el principal 'arma' ofensiva de la Fiorentina, penúltima con 4 puntos. A pesar de actuar como lateral derecho, nadie ha producido más goles (6) que Álex Jiménez, que suma dos goles y cuatro asistencias en los nueve partidos que ha disputado. Dobla, de hecho, a sus más inmediatos perseguidores: Franco Mastantuono (3+0), Mateo Pellegrino (3+0) y Alieu Njie (1+2). "En un verano que debería haber transformado la imagen del equipo, Álex Jiménez es, quizás, el único punto realmente brillante: por su personalidad y su capacidad para marcar la diferencia", sugiere 'Firenze Viola'. "Es el único recién llegado que ha mostrado un buen rendimiento hasta ahora", sugiere Bernardo Brovarone, representante de futbolistas, a 'Toscana TV'. Ya ha igualado los mejores guarismos de su carrera -en la 2024-25 anotó cuatro goles y repartió dos asistencias- y aún estamos en octubre. La mala noticia es que su producción no viene acompañada de resultados. En la derrota ante el Inter (2-1) -los 'nerazurri' remontaron con dos goles en el 91' y en el 97'- firmó, curiosamente, su obra maestra. Recibió de Fagioli a unos 25 metros de portería y conectó un misil con la diestra directo a la escuadra. Imparable para Provedel. Lo celebró con rabia, haciendo honor a su condición de ex del Milan. De hecho, durante todo el partido tuvo sus más y sus menos con la grada. "El enemigo número uno de San Siro, el hombre en el centro de la mira y los abucheos... fue el único que intentó rebelarse", reflejó 'Corriere dello Sport'. "La Fiorentina hizo poco más allá de Jiménez", apuntó Massimo Orlando, exjugador 'viola'. "Dinamismo, velocidad, habilidad en el uno contra uno y progresión con balón son las características que están permitiendo al español convertirse en una pieza cada vez más importante. Vanoli le exige disciplina sin limitar sus instintos: ese 'toque de locura' que lo impulsa a moverse hacia el centro, romper líneas y transformarse en un rematador más", escribía 'La Nazione'. Una libertad que Álex Jiménez aprovechó para repartir una nueva asistencia para Njie en el 2-2 contra la Atalanta. "Ha demostrado ser la opción ofensiva más regular de los 'viola': tras los goles contra el 'Napoli' y el Inter y el centro que propició el autogol de Vázquez contra el Genoa, asistió a Njie en el gol del empate, encontrando la regularidad esperada en Florencia", insiste 'Corriere Fiorentino'. "Vine a Florencia para mostrarle a todo el mundo el futbolista que realmente soy, para expresar el potencial que aún no he desarrollado por completo. Florencia es un lugar maravilloso para mí, y es fantástico ver lo unidos que están los aficionados al equipo y a la ciudad", aseguraba Álex Jiménez tras su gol al Nápoles. Por ahora está cumpliendo.

articles.title: Rugby League World Cup: England beat Papua New Guinea 34-12 but on brink of group-stage exit in Australia
articles.summary: Matty Ashton, AJ Brimson, Dom Young and Harry Smith scored first-half tries for England, with Morgan Knowles and Mikey Lewis adding late scores; England need Tonga to beat Samoa by over 46 points to reach the Rugby League World Cup semi-finals
articles.body:
Brian McDermott's side's qualification hopes have been out of their own hands since a heavy 30-12 defeat to Tonga in their tournament opener, and required a big win against PNG even after a 82-0 demolition of France .

England needed victory by 70 or more to overtake Samoa on points difference in the standings, which looked a possibility after they scored four tries in the first 21 minutes, only for sloppy errors and an impressive PNG display to halt early momentum.

PNG limited opponents to a penalty goal over the rest of the first half and then scored two converted tries to spark a second-half comeback, with a frustrated England going 48 minutes without a try until Morgan Knowles' score.

Mikey Lewis added another with the final play of the game, but England's 22-point winning margin is likely to be nowhere near enough to avoid a first group-stage exit in their World Cup history.

World Cup qualification hopes in tatters for England

England needed over 20 minutes to open the scoring against France but made a much faster start in this must-win contest, with Matty Ashton touching down in the corner on six minutes after an impressive offload by Herbie Farnworth.

AJ Brimson added another after a brilliant counter-attack, while a sweeping moving saw Dom Young score in the right corner to put England 16-0 up after 19 minutes.

A good offload by Kai Pearce-Paul saw Harry Smith score under the posts soon after, although a scoreless burst left them frustrated and conceding several penalties during the rest of the half.

Hugo Savala converted three of the four tries and added a penalty goal late in a half where England made multiple unforced errors, with no sizeable improvement as PNG grew further into the contest.

Dudley Dotoi powered through a series of challenges to score in the corner, following Gairo Voro's kick, with PNG celebrating again when London Broncos' Gairo Voro capitalised on England conceding six again on the line to find a second try.

England's chase for points switched to just maintaining any lead as PNG continued to push forward, with Voro fumbling the ball when having a chance to break free and Brimson later holding Dotoi up close to the line.

Knowles ended England's wait for a try in the 69th minute when he bundled over the line, while Lewis produced some late magic by evading multiple challenges and running over in the corner, although they now look set for an early exit.

"I reckon we were good in the first 20, and then the wheels kind of fell off. Too many errors. Credit to PNG, they didn't stop fighting. We weren't good enough today. Disappointing for us.

"[I'm feeling] pretty rubbish to be honest, obviously we're relying on Tonga to do more than a massive job now. There's a chance [of qualification], but a very slim one. Gutted with that. Thank you to the English fans for travelling out, appreciate your support."

"It looks like we're going out of the tournament with that score there. That second half got scrappy - the game lost its flow after about 25 minutes and I don't think there was anything to do with what we were doing.

"We should have handled that a lot better. Even the Tonga game had a bit more flow than that and that was our first time together, so that was a really difficult situation to find ourselves in the second half. If all we needed to do was win the game, we would have handled the nature of the second half a lot better."

The only way for England to avoid a pool stage exit and snatch second spot would be for Tonga to beat Samoa by 48 points or more on Sunday, the final day of group fixtures.

The team finishing runner-up in the combined Group B+C will go onto face Australia in Sydney on November 8, a day from on from the other semi-final in Newcastle, before the final is held in Brisbane on November 15.

articles.summary: The end of October has arrived, along with the ramp-up to the 2026-27 College Football Playoff (CFP), which will unveil its bracket in roughly five weeks.
articles.body:
The end of October has arrived, along with the ramp-up to the 2026-27 College Football Playoff (CFP), which will unveil its bracket in roughly five weeks.

Fourth-ranked Indiana is looking to make another push into the CFP, and the Hoosiers will likely need to survive a Week 9 matchup with Big Ten rival Minnesota to do it. The Golden Gophers, meanwhile, are sitting at 5-2 and hoping to stay alive in the conference race.

With plenty of eyes on the defending-champion Hoosiers, Bloomington will play host to ESPN's College GameDay , which will serve as a preamble to the week's marquee matchup.

Here's a look at what to expect, including scheduling information and predictions for the headline Big Ten battle.

Venue: Showalter Fountain/Memorial Stadium in Bloomington, Indiana

Crew: Rece Davis, Kirk Herbstreit, Desmond Howard, Pat McAfee, and Nick Saban

Indiana is a pretty big favorite over Minnesota, and there's a good reason for that. While the Hoosiers lost several key contributors from last year's championship team to the NFL—including quarterback Fernando Mendoza—Curt Cignetti has done an excellent job of reloading.

New quarterback Josh Hoover, a transfer from TCU, has done a very admirable job of replacing the No. 1 overall pick in April's draft. Hooever has completed 62 percent of his passes for 1,741 yards, 18 touchdowns, one interception, and a career-high QB rating of 170.9.

Though Hoover faced some scrutiny while trying to replace Mendoza early in the season, he's settled in as a reliable signal-caller.

"I'm glad he's our quarterback," Cignetti said in September, per ESPN's Adam Rittenberg .

As was the case for Mendoza last year, Hoover has largely been tasked with complementing an elite defense. The Hoosiers rank second in points allowed per game (12.0), and they'll usually have a chance to win if the offense can limit mistakes.

Indiana's only loss this season was a 19-15 contest against Ohio State.

Of course, we've seen several top teams fall in monumental upsets this year, and Minnesota is a threat to keep this one close.

Led by quarterback Drake Lindsey, running back Darius Taylor, and receiver Javon Tracy, the Golden Gophers have averaged a solid 26.6 points per game. Their defense, meanwhile, has allowed just over 20 points per game.

However, both of Minnesota's losses (versus Mississippi State and at Purdue) have come in blowout fashion. The Gophers are scrambling to keep pace in the Big Ten, which is led by Ohio State (6-1) and undefeated UCLA. Minnesota will likely need Indiana's offense to stall to have any shot at the upset.

That could happen, though, as Hoover continues to deal with an injury to his throwing arm. Hoover did not look like himself during last week's sluggish overtime win over Michigan—though Cignetti expects him to be back to form this week.

"I expect him to be fine and better this week," Cignetti said, per Michael Niziolek of The Herald-Times .

"Fine" should be good enough to get the win, but it might not be enough for Indiana to cover. The Hoosiers are just 1-7 against the spread this season, a trend that may very well continue this weekend.

articles.title: La autocrítica de Enzo Fernández por la expulsión en la final: "Es una espina que tengo clavada"
articles.standfirst: El ahora mediocentro del Manchester City pasa revista a la selección argentina tras la salida de Messi, a su nuevo equipo y la final disputada contra España
articles.summary: El ahora mediocentro del Manchester City pasa revista a la selección argentina tras la salida de Messi, a su nuevo equipo y la final disputada contra España
articles.body: La nostalgia por Lionel Messi, la herida aún abierta de la final del Mundial, la admiración por Erling Haaland, una promesa que vuelve a ilusionar a River... Enzo Fernández repasó algunos de los capítulos más importantes de su carrera en una extensa charla con los hermanos Edul Uno de los momentos más emotivos de la entrevista llegó al recordar la despedida de Messi de la selección argentina. Enzo confesó que todavía le cuesta asumir que ya no compartirá vestuario con quien fue su gran referente desde niño. "Siempre soñé jugar con él. Desde chico hacía cuentas para ver si me daba para coincidir con Messi", reconoció el centrocampista, quien reconoció que el adiós del capitán fue uno de los momentos más difíciles que ha vivido en la Albiceleste. "Después de lograr todo juntos y disfrutarlo como compañero, se me vino una tristeza enorme encima. Ya no va a estar con nosotros. Siempre te dejaba algo. Entrabas a la cancha pensando en lo que había dicho él". Enzo tampoco esquivó el análisis de la final mundialista perdida por Argentina. Lejos de buscar excusas, reconoció la superioridad de España y admitió que la selección llegó al encuentro muy castigada físicamente. "España nos sacó la pelota, manejó el partido. Fueron justos ganadores. Hay que aceptar y reconocer al rival que fue mejor". El mediocampista explicó que el desgaste acumulado tras varias eliminatorias exigentes pasó factura en el tramo decisivo del torneo. "La mitad del equipo tenía problemas físicos. El grupo llegó con lo justo". Además, asumió la responsabilidad de una de las imágenes más recordadas de aquella final: su expulsión. "Obviamente me reprocho la expulsión. A ningún jugador le gusta que lo expulsen, menos en una final del mundo. Me queda esa espina". Instalado ya en Manchester tras su último gran traspaso, Enzo aseguró sentirse plenamente integrado en el vestuario del City. Y gran parte de esa adaptación tiene nombre propio: Erling Haaland. El argentino desveló que el delantero noruego se ha sumado a una de las tradiciones más sagradas para los sudamericanos del equipo. "Siempre nos pide a mí y a Gero que le convidemos mate. Ya es una cábala antes de los partidos. Es un animal". Pero la declaración más potente para el fútbol argentino llegó cuando le preguntaron por un hipotético regreso a River. Lejos de esquivar la cuestión, Enzo fue rotundo. "Voy a volver a River en algún momento, seguro. Necesito volver a River para ganar cosas y disfrutar del mundo River más años de los que estuve". Aunque recordó que todavía tiene un largo contrato por delante en Inglaterra, el mensaje quedó claro. Enzo Fernández mira al presente con la camiseta del Manchester City, pero sigue proyectando su futuro con la banda roja sobre el pecho. Para Enzo Fernández, el fútbol mundial actual tiene nombres propios. A la hora de elegir a los mejores, el argentino no dudó en colocar a Harry Kane por delante de todos en la carrera por el Balón de Oro, acompañado en su podio por Kylian Mbappé y Lamine Yamal. Además, situó al delantero francés como el mejor futbolista del momento y destacó el crecimiento del joven talento español, de quien aseguró que tiene una carrera extraordinaria por delante y que terminará conquistando el máximo galardón individual. En su particular ranking también hubo espacio para varios compañeros y rivales a los que admira. Eligió a Cristian Romero como el mejor defensa del mundo y a David Raya como el portero más destacado de la actualidad. Preguntado por el mejor futbolista con el que ha compartido vestuario, dejando al margen a Lionel Messi, Enzo señaló a Julián Álvarez.

articles.title: El vestuario del Barça homenajea a Dani Olmo por sus 100 partidos en el Barça
articles.standfirst: Los celebró contra el PSG, encuentro en el que se lesionó
articles.summary: Los celebró contra el PSG, encuentro en el que se lesionó
articles.body: Dani Olmo no estará mañana en el Spotify Camp Nou. El centrocampista de Terrassa está lesionado, pero el futbolista internacional fue uno de los protagonistas de la sesión del Barcelona de este viernes por la mañana. El martes de la semana pasada, en el partido de Champions League contra el PSG, Dani Olmo se convirtió en centenario con el Barcelona. En el encuentro correspondiente a la tercera jornada de la fase de liga del máximo torneo europeo, el jugador de Terrassa alcanzó los 100 partidos con la camiseta azulgrana. Pero el internacional no pudo celebrar el logro conquistado porque cayó lesionado: sufrió una rotura de grado I en el aductor izquierdo que le mantendrá alejado de los terrenos de juego durante aproximadamente tres o cuatro semanas. Su evolución marcará su retorno. Para celebrar este hito, después del entrenamiento celebrado en la Ciudad Deportiva, Dani Olmo recibió una camiseta conmemorativa de sus 100 partidos con el primer equipo azulgrana. Estos cien encuentros se han repartido: 67 encuentros en LaLiga, 22 en la Champions League, ocho en la Copa del Rey y tres en la Supercopa de España. En cuanto a los goles, suma un total de 21. De ellos, 18 han llegado en la competición doméstica y tres en la máxima competición continental. En su palmarés como azulgrana cuenta con dos Ligas, una Copa del Rey y dos Supercopas de España. El dorsal 20 ha alcanzado esta cifra en su tercera temporada en el club, tras regresar al Barcelona en la campaña 2024/25.

articles.title: Luís Castro: "El Atlético es mucho mejor que el año pasado, tanto a nivel individual como colectivo"
articles.standfirst: El entrenador portugués ha confirmado la vuelta de Dela a la convocatoria y la baja de Bardeli por lesión
articles.summary: El entrenador portugués ha confirmado la vuelta de Dela a la convocatoria y la baja de Bardeli por lesión
articles.body: El técnico del Levante habló en rueda de prensa previo al duelo que enfrenta a su equipo al Atlético de Madrid este próximo sábado, a partir de las 14.00 horas. "Es lo que hay. Tenemos que concentrarnos y hacerlo de la menor manera posible. Todos queríamos jugar, pero ninguna persona quería que ocurriera el accidente. Tenemos que cambiar el chip y concentrarnos en el Atlético de Madrid" "Dela ya está bien. Está al 100% y no tiene ningún problema. Bardeli está cerca de venir y no vamos a correr ningún riesgo. Necesita un poco más" "Es un Atlético muy diferente al de la temporada pasada. Tanto en términos colectivos como individuales, para mí y para mi staff, está mejor. Tiene más soluciones, no ha perdido jugadores claves y ha conseguido no venderlos, y cuando no vendes y metes a otros dentro, mejoras seguro. Tácticamente tienen más variedad. Es un Atlético más fuerte por eso solo han perdido un partido en esta liga" "No es la primera vez que están en el entrenamiento. Normalmente hablamos siempre. La conversación ya no me acuerdo. Hablamos del club y de cosas normales, de cosas particulares. Es posible que salga de aquí y hablemos un poco más. No es la primera vez. No es nada especial" "Yo ya he comentado esta pregunta y yo intentaré no comentarla más. No sé si es posible. Ahora, si tú me preguntas por la preparación de partido, me gustaría tener cuanto más tiempo posible, mejor. La probabilidad de ganar es mayor. Quiero igualdad para todos los equipos" "En primer lugar, Etta viene de lesión y no ha estado al 100%. Es normal que no sea opción clara de jugar los noventa minutos, por lo tanto, miramos cómo evoluciona físicamente. También necesitas jugadores que cambien las cosas y Etta está entrando bien. Pero tenemos otras opciones en la plantilla" "No será el mismo once que el último partido y sobre el sistema, que ya hablé el año pasado de esto, nosotros defendemos con cuatro o con cinco y presionamos con extremos más alto y con media punta y delantero. Tú puedes jugar con los mismos jugadores y la dinámica puede ser diferente, dependiendo del rival. Lo más importante es que ellos comprendan lo que pides en cada momento. Yo hablo muchas veces del sistema, pero si haces fotos desde arriba, nunca tendrás las mismas posiciones de los jugadores. El sistema depende de los jugadores que juegan, de la dinámica y del adversario. En nosotros, el sistema no es una cosa tan clara"

articles.title: El derbi recreará la mítica imagen de 1976
articles.standfirst: Athletic y Real Sociedad acuerdan homenajear la foto de hace medio siglo con la misma bandera y mismos protagonistas
articles.summary: Athletic y Real Sociedad acuerdan homenajear la foto de hace medio siglo con la misma bandera y mismos protagonistas
articles.body: El Athletic Club y la Real Sociedad recrearán, 50 años después, este domingo la mítica imagen de aquél 5 de diciembre de 1976, con Jose Angel Iribar e Inaxio Kortabarria al frente. Un gesto que quedó para siempre ligado a la historia de los clubes de fútbol. Lo sucedido el 5 de diciembre de 1976 en Atotxa forma parte de la memoria compartida de la Real Sociedad, del Athletic Club y de la sociedad vasca en su conjunto. La imagen de ambos equipos, capitaneados por Inaxio Kortabarria y Jose Angel Iribar, saltando al terreno de juego con la ikurriña se convirtió en un símbolo que cinco décadas después mantiene intacto su valor histórico y social. Fruto de una iniciativa compartida entre Real Sociedad y Athletic Club, aquella histórica acción se repetirá el próximo domingo, en los instantes previos al partido de la jornada 11 de LaLiga EA Sports que disputarán Athletic Club y Real Sociedad en San Mamés. José Ángel Iribar e Inaxio Kortabarria accederán de nuevo al terreno de juego portando la ikurriña original utilizada en Atotxa y serán recibidos por un pasillo formado por los actuales futbolistas zurigorris y txuri urdines. A continuación, todos ellos posarán conjuntamente para recrear una de las imágenes más emblemáticas de la historia reciente de ambos clubes y rendir tributo a la iniciativa impulsada por los jugadores de los dos equipos en 1976. Ambas entidades animan a las personas que asistirán al partido a acceder al estadio con la suficiente antelación para poder presenciar y participar en este homenaje

articles.title: El Barça, el rival que cambió la vida de Koski
articles.standfirst: El finlandés se estrenó como titular en la antepenúltima jornada del pasado curso ante el Barcelona, firmó una actuación estelar y desde entonces ha sido una pieza indiscutible para Quique.
articles.summary: El finlandés se estrenó como titular en la antepenúltima jornada del pasado curso ante el Barcelona, firmó una actuación estelar y desde entonces ha sido una pieza indiscutible para Quique.
articles.body: Hay partidos que cambian el rumbo de una temporada. A veces hay que esperar hasta la recta final. El último encuentro que midió al Alavés con el Barcelona el pasado 13 de mayo es un ejemplo de ello. El conjunto babazorro se encaminaba peligrosamente hacia el precipicio, pero esquivó la bala del descenso en una semana completa que comenzó venciendo al Barcelona, proclamado cuatro días antes campeón de la Liga, y rematando la faena en el Carlos Tartiere. El duelo ante el Barcelona aún está presente en Vitoria. El Alavés logró dejar la puerta a cero después encajar goles de forma consecutiva en 20 partidos y por primera vez en los últimos 12 años, el cuadro catalán se quedaba sin rematar a puerta. Una actuación defensiva estratosférica que tuvo en Ville Koski a uno de los grandes protagonistas. La visita del Barça a Mendizorroza cambió la vida del central finlandés. Koski aterrizó en Vitoria en el mercado invernal lesionado y apenas sumó 11 minutos de competición en sus primeros tres meses como babazorro. Ni Coudet ni tampoco Quique le tenían presente en sus planes. Sin embargo, el técnico madrileño buscó un golpe de timón en una defensa que coleccionaba demasiados errores que le habían llevado a coquetear con Segunda. Su apuesta por Koski llegó en el día menos oportuno. La visita del Barcelona siempre supone un estrés superior al habitual para los defensas. Sin embargo, el Alavés completó una gran actuación sin balón que tuvo en el finlandés a uno de sus baluartes. Desde entonces, el central ha sido una pieza imprescindible para Quique hasta el punto de ser titular en 12 de los últimos 13 partidos. Koski fue decisivo en el triunfo ante el Barça, que acumulaba 56 jornadas seguidas marcando hasta su visita a Mendizorroza, repitió como titular frente al Oviedo para certificar la permanencia y su actuación en la última semana de competición fue suficiente para que el Alavés decidiera ejecutar la opción de compra que figuraba en su cesión. Hoy vuelve a verse las caras ante el rival que le cambió la vida en un contexto diferente y con todas las incógnitas que giraban sobre su figura resueltas.

articles.title: Robbie Savage: Forest Green launch legal action against Peterborough
articles.summary: Forest Green chairman Dale Vince announces the club is taking legal action against Peterborough United.
articles.body:
Forest Green Rovers owner Dale Vince says the club has launched legal action against Peterborough United over its approach for former manager Robbie Savage.

The Welshman left earlier this month to join the League One side, despite Vince initially blocking the discussions. Vince later claimed he was forced to agree to the move when the 51-year-old was approached directly.

Vince made the announcement in a short video on social media , external , revealing Forest Green had "begun a legal process for the tapping up of our manager, now ex-manager, Robbie Savage".

Peterborough United offered no comment on the legal action when contacted by BBC Sport, but have previously denied making an illegal approach for Savage.

Savage joined Forest Green Rovers after a successful stint at the then-seventh tier Macclesfield FC - the phoenix club formed after Macclesfield Town was wound up in 2020.

During his time with the Silkmen, the club sealed promotion to National League North, scoring 109 goals and winning 109 points.

When he arrived in Gloucestershire in July 2025, he went on to guide Forest Green to the play-offs with the campaign ending in defeat to Boreham Wood.

It would turn out to be his only full season in charge, with Savage leaving the club on 2 October, with them sitting 13th after 11 matches .

At the time, Vince told BBC Radio Gloucestershire that he initially refused Peterborough permission to speak to Savage but relented after he said the club approached him directly.

"Peterborough themselves have covered themselves in no glory here. They came to us and said, 'We would like to speak to your manager,'" he told BBC Radio Gloucestershire 10 days after the appointment.

"We said no, and so they spoke to him, and then he came to us and said, 'I hear Peterborough want to speak to me.' So, that's an illegal approach."

Posh chairman Darren MacAnthony hit back against the claims, writing on X that the process to appoint a new manager was "100% correct and proper, following all the rules".

Since joining Peterborough, Savage's record has been two wins, two draws and two losses in all competitions.

articles.title: Mika Mármol, la roca que sostiene el liderato del Feyenoord: "Mejora al equipo desde el primer momento"
articles.standfirst: El ex de Las Palmas brilla alternando la posición de lateral izquierdo y la de central
articles.summary: El ex de Las Palmas brilla alternando la posición de lateral izquierdo y la de central
articles.body: Giovanni van Bronckhorst ha encontrado en Mika Mármol (Tarrasa, 2001) a su particular Fede Valverde. Necesitaría dos. El ex de Las Palmas, que recaló libre en el Feyenoord este verano, se ha convertido en indiscutible dentro del líder de la Eredivisie. Es el jugador de campo que más minutos acumula (1.141) y ha participado en los 13 partidos que ha disputado el conjunto de Róterdam hasta la fecha, nueve como lateral izquierdo -alterna con el español Javi López- y cuatro como central. "Acelera la salida de balón de los de Róterdam con dos armas fundamentales: sus pases y su regate. Con el balón, Mármol cumple a la perfección con su cometido y mejora al Feyenoord desde el primer momento", asegura 'ESPN'. "Parecían un poco perdedores en el mercado de fichajes porque no habían traído a ningún jugador de renombre, pero Mármol, por ejemplo, lo está haciendo muy bien", asegura Chris Woerts, exdirector de Márketing del Feyenoord, a 'FCUpdate'. Los datos de 'Opta', entre los jugadores de la Eredivisie con, al menos, 350 minutos disputados, le avalan. El ex de Barcelona, Andorra y Las Palmas, actuando como central, puede presumir de ser el que más pases progresivos (que recorren más de 10 metros hacia la portería rival) realiza por 90' (11,2), el segundo que más conducciones progresivas efectúa (2,8), el octavo que más duelos defensivos gana (6,42) y el noveno que más balones recupera (8,6). Su repertorio, jugando de lateral izquierdo, es, si cabe, más amplio: es el segundo que más balones recupera por 90' (7,5), que más pases en largo efectúa (5,4) y el segundo con mayor porcentaje de duelos ganados (58,7%). Se sitúa, además, como el tercero con más pases progresivos (11) y el sexto que más interceptaciones (5,6) y más jugadas clave genera (1). Jugadas clave que han deparado en dos asistencias. “La estabilidad que demuestra se debe al estilo de juego al que está acostumbrado. También se nota en la comodidad que muestra con el balón. Debo decir que no me sorprendió del todo, pero me alegro por él, y por nosotros como club y equipo, de que se haya adaptado tan rápido”, apunta Van Bronckhorst. Mármol le está agradecido al ex del Barça. "Habla español muy bien. Es muy cercano y lo aprecio mucho. Para un jugador es importante que el entrenador sea accesible", apuntaba en 'ESPN' antes de indroducir un matiz táctico: "Él jugaba de lateral y creo que eso también me ayuda. Me da consejos sobre esa posición, sobre todo en defensa, pero también en ataque. Eso me ayuda muchísimo". El 'Spanish' Feyenoord vuela: es líder con tres puntos más que el Ajax. En De Kuip, la unión hace la fuerza. "Es genial. Ya conocía a Javi López de LaLiga. A Nacho no le conocía, pero nos llevamos muy bien y hemos formado un buen grupo. Estamos juntos casi todo el tiempo: desayunamos juntos, comemos juntos...y también estamos juntos en el vestuario". Con la 'roca' Mika Mármol todo es más fácil.

articles.body: El Real Madrid regresa a la competición liguera tras su conquista al Camp Nou. articles.title: Jeglertz frustrated with Manchester City’s latest Champions League draw
articles.summary: Manchester City head coach Andrée Jeglertz was frustrated after watching his side draw 1-1 with Paris Saint-Germain at The Joie Stadium last night.The Cityze...
articles.body:
Manchester City head coach Andrée Jeglertz was frustrated after watching his side draw 1-1 with Paris Saint-Germain at The Joie Stadium last night.

The Cityzens looked to have won the game with an 85th-minute penalty from Khadija Shaw, but the visitors soon levelled through Tara Elimbi Gilbert. It was Manchester City's third consecutive draw in this season's UEFA Women's Champions League.

Speaking to the media after the game, Jeglertz admitted that he was frustrated with the result.

"The performance was good," Jeglertz said. "I think there are a lot of things in this game that we are pleased with; scoring chances, controlling the game.

"The result is not what we wanted. It was frustrating to concede a goal that late. Maybe we should kill the game earlier, so we don't end up like that because we have the momentum so many times in the second half where we have the ball in and around their box. Annoying is not the right word, but I think it's a little bit of a feeling that we deserved more in the game. That's how it is in Champions League; if you dominate games and you don't score, the opponent will take their chances and that's what they do."

Commenting further on the performance, Jeglertz said that this game was his side's most complete European showing so far.

He said "I think the games have been very different. I think this is the best game over 90 minutes in Champions League so far. The other games, we had a good second half against Bayern and Real Madrid. Now we have 90 minutes. I think in general, we had one period in the first half where we were a little bit under pressure, but otherwise it's 90 minutes, that is the best one so far.

"It's more about winning the games because they were happy coming here and getting a point, that was very clear, that was what they wanted."

Jeglertz also spoke about the challenges of balancing squad selection with Manchester City playing more games than this time last season.

He said "I think this year is more challenging in our position because we are planning to play a lot of games. What I could do last year was almost play the same line-up all of the time. That came earlier into relationships, it was easier to build relationships.

"Our relationship will be perfect in spring, because that's when everything is going to be finalised; when the league is going to be determined, Champions League [final] is going to be, FA Cup [final]. That's when we're going to be ready, which means that it takes a little bit longer time now. I can't expect that the relationship is 100-percent now in October. I think it was easier last year since we didn't rotate that much. I think it has to be like that because we are planning for going further in spring, so that's the reason [for rotation and changes]."

Manchester City are next in action on Sunday afternoon when they travel to London City Lionesses in the Barclays Women's Super League.

articles.title: Troy Aikman, Joe Buck spat comes further to light: 'Never thought you’d do it to me'
articles.summary: A new report reveals what Troy Aikman and Joe Buck said when they had their public argument after Buck's new contract.
articles.body:
The Troy Aikman and Joe Buck saga continues to swirl after the play-by-play legend got a new contract and the Hall of Famer didn't.

There was the argument that they had earlier this month that was reported everywhere, and since then, there have been some perceived icy Monday Night Football moments on the air. So what exactly happened on the field at SoFi Stadium that night? The Athletic's Andrew Marchand has reported on it.

He said that Aikman and Buck met with ESPN chairman Jimmy Pitaro before the Los Angeles Rams game, and then it started with Buck saying, "You are not going to [expletive] talk to me?"

Aikman, according to sources aware of his thinking, felt Buck wanted to force a public backlash to appear as the good guy. As the discussion went on, Buck defended himself by saying, "I'm not the reason you don't have a contract." The 59-year-old Aikman, who sources said had long harbored feelings that Buck was behind the incessant producer and director turnover during their "Monday Night" tenure, shot back, "I just never thought you'd do it to me." articles.title: Anselmi no se fía del Valencia: "Sabemos de su magnitud como club"
articles.standfirst: El técnico del Elche apela a la concentración para prolongar la buena dinámica ante un rival al que reconoce su dimensión histórica
articles.summary: El técnico del Elche apela a la concentración para prolongar la buena dinámica ante un rival al que reconoce su dimensión histórica
articles.body: Martín Anselmi no quiere confianzas ante el Valencia. El entrenador del Elche espera un partido de máxima exigencia este domingo (18:30 horas) en el Martínez Valero, donde los franjiverdes buscarán prolongar su buen momento y conseguir una victoria ante uno de los grandes del fútbol español. El técnico argentino ha advertido de que la situación clasificatoria del conjunto valencianista no debe llevar a engaño y espera una reacción de un equipo acostumbrado a competir en escenarios de máxima exigencia. "Es un rival que no viene pasando sus mejores momentos en los últimos años, pero sabemos de su magnitud como club. Cuando no pasan por su mejor momento tienden a rebelarse", ha señalado Anselmi, que ha destacado la calidad de la plantilla valencianista y la capacidad de su entrenador, Aguirre, para gestionar este tipo de situaciones. "Tiene una trayectoria y un recorrido inmenso. Sabe manejar estos momentos, le ha dado al equipo esa soltura que venía necesitando", ha añadido. El preparador franjiverde quiere evitar que la necesidad de conseguir la primera victoria en casa se convierta en una carga para sus futbolistas. Su discurso pasa por disfrutar del presente y mantener la atención en el rendimiento, sin obsesionarse con los resultados como local o visitante. "Estamos disfrutando mucho del presente como para tener ansiedad. Trato de disfrutar de lo que somos como equipo y ahí poner el foco", ha explicado. En esa misma línea, ha lanzado un mensaje sobre la gestión de la presión: "Tenemos que naturalizar el miedo a la presión. Si repetimos cada semana en poner el foco en competir, el resto pasa a ser un ruido externo". El Elche llega al encuentro después de encadenar tres porterías a cero, una estadística que refleja la solidez defensiva adquirida por el equipo. Anselmi considera que mantener la portería imbatida es determinante, pero no quiere que esa seguridad limite la ambición ofensiva de los suyos. "Siempre tener la portería a cero es determinante. Con eso te aseguras un punto y es muy difícil. Tenemos que seguir siendo nosotros y eso implica manejar bien la pelota, tratar de lastimar más o hacer más daño cuando tenemos ese tipo de situaciones", ha explicado. Para el argentino, la clave está en el funcionamiento colectivo: "Nuestra mejor versión es ser un equipo". También ha tenido palabras para Pedro Bigas, después del error cometido por el central en el compromiso copero ante la UD Pinatar. Anselmi ha recordado que el futbolista no pudo completar la pretemporada y que necesita recuperar ritmo competitivo, pero ha defendido su capacidad y profesionalidad. "Todos sabemos de su calidad y que no es un jugador propenso a cometer errores. A nivel mental es un ser competitivo, siempre da el ejemplo en todos los aspectos", ha afirmado. El entrenador está convencido de que el capitán se sobrepondrá a este episodio, como ya ocurrió con Dituro en un momento anterior de la temporada. Por último, ha reivindicado la competencia interna como uno de los motores del crecimiento del equipo. "Si te relajas, te ganan el lugar. Una buena competencia te invita a superarte", ha concluido Anselmi, que espera que el Elche mantenga su identidad y dé continuidad a su progresión ante el Valencia.

Y en ataque Oyarzabal y Guedes serían fijos, con Sucic, Barrenetxea y Kubo optando a las otras dos plazas, porque Óskarsson parece que esta vez estará de inicio en el banquillo.

articles.title: How will Atlético Madrid line up against Levante in La Liga?
articles.summary: Atlético travel to Valencia looking for a seventh consecutive LaLiga victory.
articles.body:
Atlético de Madrid (8-1-1, 25 points) return to LaLiga action Saturday afternoon when they travel to the Ciutat de València to face Levante UD (2-4-4, 10 points).

Diego Simeone's side enter the weekend in excellent form, having won six consecutive LaLiga matches and gone unbeaten in their last eight matches across all competitions. Atlético currently sit second in LaLiga, just two points behind league leaders FC Barcelona.

Most recently, Los Rojiblancos secured a narrow 1-0 victory over Deportivo A Coruña at the Metropolitano last Saturday. Julián Alvarez scored the only goal of the match shortly after halftime, while Jan Oblak was once again called upon late to preserve the three points.

Although Atlético have continued their excellent domestic form, the performances have not always been particularly convincing. Four of their last six league victories have come by a single goal, and Simeone's side has struggled at times to put away opponents despite creating good opportunities.

One of the biggest positives has been the improvement defensively. Atlético have conceded just eight goals through their opening 10 league matches and have kept consecutive clean sheets against Espanyol and Deportivo.

However, with Bayern Munich and Barcelona awaiting Atlético in their next two matches, Saturday's visit to Valencia could prove to be a difficult test. Managing minutes and avoiding additional injuries will be important considerations for Simeone as Atlético enter one of their most challenging stretches of the season.

Levante enter Saturday's match sitting 14th in LaLiga with 10 points from their opening 10 matches. Luís Castro's side has struggled to find consistency this season; the Granotas are coming off a 2-1 defeat to Real Sociedad last Sunday, just four days after recording an impressive 3-1 victory over Athletic Club at the Ciutat de València.

Despite their position in the table, Levante have been a particularly dangerous attacking side at home. Through their opening four league matches at the Ciutat de València, Castro's men have scored 13 goals, including five against Real Betis, three against Sevilla and three against Athletic Club.

However, their attacking success has been accompanied by significant defensive struggles. Levante have conceded 19 goals through 10 league matches, including 10 in their four home fixtures. Those defensive vulnerabilities should present opportunities for Atlético's attacking players, particularly Alvarez and Álex Baena, who have been among the most important contributors during the team's recent unbeaten streak.

One player Atlético will need to keep an eye on is Levante captain Roger Brugué. The Spanish winger scored twice in the victory over Athletic Club and has been one of the more dangerous attacking players in Castro's squad. Iván Romero and Petar Ratkov provide additional attacking options, while former Atlético defender Manu Sánchez is expected to feature on the left side of Levante's defense.

Diego Simeone continues to deal with injury concerns, particularly in midfield, as Atlético prepare for Saturday's match.

Koke and Johnny Cardoso remain sidelined with muscular injuries and have continued working separately from the squad. Both players missed last weekend's victory over Deportivo, and neither is expected to feature against Levante.

There is better news regarding Cristian Romero , who has returned to full training after he missed Atlético's previous two matches against Stuttgart and Deportivo. The Argentine defender has featured in Simeone's preparations for Saturday's match and could return directly to the starting lineup.

Simeone experimented with Marcos Llorente alongside Pablo Barrios in midfield during training this week, which would see Morten Hjulmand move to the bench ahead of Tuesday's Champions League match against Bayern Munich. Hjulmand will be suspended for that match following his red card against Stuttgart, so the logical thing would be for him to receive minutes at Levante.

There could also be changes in attack, with Giuliano Simeone pushing for a return to the starting lineup and Jonathan David , Ademola Lookman , Kang-in Lee and Alexander Sørloth all options for rotation. With Bayern Munich and Barcelona up next, Simeone will need to manage his squad carefully without overlooking Saturday's opponent.

Historically, Atlético have enjoyed the better of their meetings with Levante, boasting a 21-8-9 all-time record in LaLiga. However, the Ciutat de València has not been a particularly welcoming destination for Simeone's side. Atlético have not recorded a league victory at Levante's home stadium since June 2020, when an own goal from Bruno González was enough for a 1-0 win.

The most recent meeting between the clubs at the Ciutat de València came in January, when Atlético were held to a disappointing scoreless draw. Earlier that same season, Atlético recorded a 3-1 victory over Levante at the Metropolitano, with Antoine Griezmann scoring twice and an own goal from Adrián de la Fuente further helping Los Rojiblancos grab all three points.

articles.standfirst: El técnico valora cómo está su vestuario antes de recibir al Alavés
articles.summary: El técnico valora cómo está su vestuario antes de recibir al Alavés
articles.body: Hansi Flick desgranó cómo está su vestuario tras la derrota en el Clásico y antes de recibir mañana sábado la visita del Alavés en el Spotify Camp Nou. El técnico aseguró que no ve a Balde con confianza, que Brian se merece jugar y se mostró seguro de que su equipo reaccionará de inmediato y dejará atrás los tropiezos. Así mismo, agradeció el apoyo de la Junta a su trabajo, pero está seguro y feliz de su trabajo en el banquillo culé. Accidente "En nombre de los jugadores y en el mío, quiero enviar nuestro sincero pésame a todos los afectados por el accidente de tren en Toledo. Estamos al lado de las familias, les enviamos todo nuestro amor". Raphinha, selección "He hablado con Deco. Es un jugador muy importante y tras el descanso por los partidos de las selecciones, llegó lesionado. No es la mejor situación. Pero las cosas son así y no podemos hacer nada. Rapha lleva el club en el corazón, pero si le llama la selección... quiere estar ahí. Todos quieren ayudar a la selección brasileña. Si podemos gestionar sus minutos, me alegraría. No es lo mejor ir y volver a Singapur. Pero no está en mis manos". Dos derrotas "Es lo que digo siempre, el camino es largo. Es un buen momento, no pasa nada irreversible. Hemos perdido contra el Real Madrid y no le gusta a nadie, pero hay que gestionarlo y creo que pudimos ganarlo. Pero hay que asumir la derrota y aprender de ella. Jules está fuera, Espart, Olmo, Eric, Christensen... nos faltan cuatro atrás. Hay que buscar soluciones, y en eso estamos. Mañana tenemos que ganar los tres puntos". Lamine Yamal - Balón de Oro "Creo que Kane se merecía también ganarlo. Ya sabéis mi opinión de Lamine, también está al nivel de conquistarlo. Se lo dije a él y al equipo, me pareció fantástico que hablara de Cubarsí, que también se merecía ganar el Kopa. Fue un gran gesto y Cubarsí también se merecía ganarlo. Estoy muy orgulloso de Lamine, reaccionó muy bien. Le veo muy concentrado, así responden los campeones. Estoy contento de su mentalidad, que es buena para el equipo. Me alegro de que se haya acabado y así nos podemos centrar en otras cosas". Fichaje de un central "Siempre buscamos lo mejor para el equipo. Y lo estamos haciendo. Ya veremos, faltan aún unas semanas para que llegue el mercado de invierno. Si podemos hacer algo, tal vez lo hagamos". Juego aéreo "Al final, defender no es sólo un trabajo de la zaga. Hasta el delantero debe estar implicado. No hay que perder el balón fácilmente, eso lo primero. Perdimos algunos contra el Real Madrid. Nos faltó frescura, pero nos pasó en otros partidos también. Hay que jugar más centrados y con más cabeza. Y al defender en el área es importante marcar bien a los rivales, y esto no lo hicimos muy bien. Lo hemos entrenado y hablado". Semana limpia "Sabemos que todos deben estar centrados y hay que tener una reacción adecuada. Son dos derrotas, pero el equipo está jugando bien, tiene confianza en su fuerza y calidad. Hoy el entrenamiento ha sido bueno, hay buen estado de ánimo y buen ambiente. Y hay que demostrarlo mañana. El Alavés defiende bien, pero somos el Barça y queremos demostrar nuestra mejor versión". Tunkara "Venía de una lesión, pero jugó algunos minutos. Hizo la pretemporada con nosotros. Me gusta lo que he visto. Hace un buen trabajo. Puede pasar cualquier cosa". Rodri "Le pido lo mismo de siempre al equipo. Hay que tener menos pérdidas de balón y más posesión. Si controlas el partido, decides cómo circula el balón y controlas mejor al rival. No hay que perderlo, porque si no tienes que correr detrás y esto no es bueno para nosotros. Lo mejor es no cometer errores. Tiene razón Rodri cuando dice que hay que controlar el juego y mantener la calma". Laterales y cantera "Podría reservar a uno. Brian es muy inteligente. Se entrena con nosotros desde el inicio de temporada. Hace un trabajo fantástico. Se merece jugar ya". De Jong "Para mí es un jugador muy importante, cuando está al cien por cien es increíble. Tiene una gran calidad con el balón y una gran mentalidad. Nos ayuda en defensa. Es un gran jugador, nos hace subir de nivel". Balde "De Jong puede jugar de central. Sólo están Cubarsí y Gerard de centrales, y es importante buscar soluciones. Lo estamos gestionando. Frenkie puede moverse en varias posiciones. Y Balde no tiene ahora la confianza que necesita en su juego, ni la convicción... los defensas son muy importantes. Necesita esta confianza para estar a su mejor nivel". Apoyo de la Junta directiva "Hablo con el presidente y con Deco... y está bien el gesto porque es bonito que te den confianza, pero conozco la situación. Son dos derrotas. Pero hago mi trabajo de la mejor forma que puedo. Estoy muy contento de estar aquí y nada ha cambiado. Ganamos 11 partidos y ahora hay dos derrotas, y tenemos que volver a ganar. Pero nuestra idea de cómo jugar es la mejor para este equipo. Seguiremos así hasta el final".
